editorial:
Imagine finding the absolute perfect guy who loves cats and cooks amazing meals, only to realize your life is about to flip upside down because you are pregnant. That is exactly what happens to Josephine, a woman who is definitely not ready to be a responsible adult. You will find her struggle relatable and hilarious as she tries to juggle a new job, a messy sister who won't leave, and the terrifying fear of turning into her own mother. The vibe is lighthearted and chaotic, making it the kind of movie you put on when you just want to laugh at someone else's life falling apart in a funny way.

You will love how the acting feels natural and the pacing keeps things moving quickly so you never get bored. While the plot is pretty simple, the charm comes from Josephine's quirky personality and her clumsy attempts to grow up. If you enjoy stories about messy women finding their way, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After all the chaos and fighting with her family, Josephine finally learns how to balance her own needs with the needs of her baby. She manages to set boundaries with her sister and finds a way to be a mature adult without losing her funny spark. The movie wraps up with her and her partner happily preparing for the baby, proving that she can be both fabulous and responsible at the same time.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves romantic comedies about growing up.
